sloka: हस्ति अश्व रथ संभाधा तूर्य नाद विनादिता ।सर्व काम फलैः वृक्षैः संकुल उद्यान भूषिता ॥३-४८-१२॥
transliteration: hasti aśva ratha saṁbhādhā tūrya nāda vināditā ।sarva kāma phalaiḥ vṛkṣaiḥ saṁkula udyāna bhūṣitā ॥3-48-12॥

translations.english: It is crowded with elephants, horses and chariots. It resounds with the music of trumpets. The trees in the delightful pleasuregardens yield fruits in all seasons.
